message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as challenging, particularly when dealing with flying machines. He mentions that the combat can be tricky sometimes, and suggests that one should use a bow with elemental arrows to stun the flying machines and make taking them down easier. Additionally, Dyllan recommends utilizing the "focus" ability to track the movements of these flying foes, which helps in dodging their attacks effectively. He also notes that setting up traps could be a useful strategy to counteract the challenges presented by the flying machines.
